what: Every web page the application may open in the operator's browser (QGD-SEC-0009, QGD-FRM-0015, QGD-STN-0011). A page is opened only from here: Help's documents by name, and a park or summit by a reference checked against its form. Before Release 1 the documents are read from develop, which is where they are; Release 1 changes the branch to main.
